method: Sequential full-corpus fresh processes. Primary metric: prepared.matching_seconds. Includes batch claims, all per-request filters, signature checks, complete service priority/deduplication and storing results in memory. Excludes file reading, JSON decoding, normalization, compilation, worker startup/destruction, postprocessing, JSON serialization, writes and flush. First-use search cache work is included. Every request is processed once in total. No affinity, explicit warm-up, cache reset or fsync. Actual outputs are checked outside application timing. Diagnostics perturb performance and are kept out of ordinary summaries. Baseline is historical unless --baseline is explicitly selected.

literal_search_experiments.reason: The three-repeat comparison did not confirm a parallel throughput benefit; ordinary checked indexing was retained.

literal_search_profile.method: Fresh full-corpus diagnostic processes; identical literal occurrence and presence counts. Diagnostic stage timings include instrumentation and are separate from ordinary throughput medians.
